title: 48 Swahili Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Swahili for Beginners (Purpose)
description:
Learn 48 essential Swahili phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Swahili #LearnSwahili #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in Kiswahili, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Swahili with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 48 real-life phrases
- Kiswahili audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Purpose · Kusudi
1:21  Friendship · Urafiki
2:36  Hobbies & Free Time · Mambo ya Kufanya na Wakati wa Upole
4:00  Weather & Small Talk · Hali ya Hewa na Mazungumzo Madogo
5:23  Happiness · Furaha
6:44  Meeting People & Greetings · Kukutana na Watu na Salamu
7:58  Patience · Subira
9:16  Creativity · Ubunifu

PHRASE LIST

PURPOSE · Kusudi
• My purpose is to listen first. - Kusudi langu ni kusikiliza kwanza.  [KU-Su-di laNGU ni ku-SI-Ki-LIza Kwanza.]
• I’m choosing this with a reason. - Nimechagua hili kwa sababu.  [Ni-me-CHAA-ga hi-li kwa SAu-ba.]
• Let’s focus, what are we aiming for? - Tuimarishe fikira, tunalenga nini?  [Tui-ma-RI-SHE fi-KI-ra, tu-na-LEN-ga NINi?]
• I want clarity, not just activity. - Nataka ufafanuzi, si shughuli tu.  [Na-TA-ka u-fa-FAN-u-zi, si SHAU-ga ya TU.]
• I’m doing this so it works. - Nafanya hivi ili kifanye kazi.  [Na-FAn-a hi-vi i-li ki-FAn-ye KA-zi.]
• My purpose today is to help you. - Kusudi langu leo ni kukusaidia.  [KU-Su-di laNGU le-O ni ku-KU-SAI-di-a.]

FRIENDSHIP · Urafiki
• Thanks for always showing up. - Asante kwa kunionyesha mara zote.  [Asante kwa ku-ni-ONYESHA ma-ra zote.]
• I’m in your corner, truly. - Nipo upande wako, kweli.  [Ni-po UPANDE wa-ko, KWAELI.]
• Let’s be honest with each other. - Tuambiane ukweli kwa kila jambo.  [Tua-mia-ne u-KWELI kwa KI-la JAMBO.]
• Your smile lifts my whole day. - Tabasamu lako linainua siku yangu yote.  [Ta-ba-sa-mu la-ko li-na-INUA si-ku yangu YO-TE.]
• When you need space, I understand. - Ukipata muda wa kupumua, naelewa.  [U-ki-pa-ta MUDA wa ku-puMU-a, na-ELE-wa.]
• I’ll text you, just to check in. - Nitakutumia ujumbe, nikuulize hali.  [Ni-ta-ku-TU-ma u-jUMBE, ni-ku-U-LIZE haLI.]

HOBBIES & FREE TIME · Mambo ya Kufanya na Wakati wa Upole
• I like to slow down with tea. - Napenda kupunguza mwendo, nikinywa chai.  [NAPENDA kupunguza MWENDO, nikinywa chai.]
• I read a few pages, just for me. - Ninasoma kurasa chache, ni kwa ajili yangu.  [NINASOMA kurasa chache, ni kwa ajili YANGU.]
• I take my camera out on weekends. - Ninatoka na kamera wikendi.  [NINATOKA na KAMERA wikiendi.]
• I stretch for ten minutes, feeling lighter. - Nafanya kunyoosha kwa dakika kumi, najisikia mwepesi.  [NAFANYA kunyoosha kwa DAKIKA kumi, NAJISIKIA mwepesi.]
• I make simple crafts when I’m free. - Nafanya kazi rahisi za ufundi nikipata muda.  [NAfanya kazi rahisi za UFUNDI nikipata Muda.]
• I play soft music and tidy up. - Nacheza muziki wa taratibu, halafu ninaweka sawa.  [NACHEZA MUZIKI wa taratibu, HAlafu ninaweka SAWA.]

WEATHER & SMALL TALK · Hali ya Hewa na Mazungumzo Madogo
• This weather makes me want to walk. - Hali ya hewa inanifanya nitake kutembea.  [Hali ya hewa INANIFANYA nITake kutembea.]
• I love how the air feels right now. - Ninapenda jinsi hewa inavyohisi sasa hivi.  [NINAPENDA jinsi hewa INAVYohisi sasa hivi.]
• Is it going to rain soon? - Mvua itanyesha muda si mrefu, siyo?  [Mvua itanyesha MUDA si mrefu, sio?]
• The sky looks calmer than yesterday. - Anga linaonekana tulivu kuliko jana.  [ANGA linaonekana tulivu KULIKO jana.]
• I’m adjusting my schedule because of clouds. - Narekebisha ratiba yangu kwa sababu ya mawingu.  [NAREKEBISHA RATIBA yangu kwa sababu ya MAWINGU.]
• That breeze is helping my shoulders relax. - Upepo huo unaniwezesha kupumzisha mabega yangu.  [UPEPO huo UNANIwezesha kupumZISHA mabega yangu.]

HAPPINESS · Furaha
• Today, I’m grateful for small joys - Leo, ninashukuru furaha ndogo ndogo  [Leo, ninashukuru FURAHA ndogo ndogo]
• I forgive myself, and I move on - Ninasamehe moyo wangu, na naendelea  [NINASAMEHE moyo wangu, na NAENDELEA]
• My laugh feels easy, right now - Kicheko changu ni chepesi, sasa hivi  [KICHEKO changu ni CHEPESI, sasa HIVI]
• I notice beauty in ordinary moments - Ninaona uzuri katika wakati wa kawaida  [NAIONA UZURI katika WAKATI wa kawaida]
• Peace lives in my daily routine - Amani ipo kwenye ratiba yangu ya kila siku  [AMAni ipo kwenye RATIBA yangu ya KILA siku]
• I feel proud of how I showed up - Ninajivunia jinsi nilivyofika hapo  [NINAJIVUNIA jinsi NILIVYOFIKA hapo]

MEETING PEOPLE & GREETINGS · Kukutana na Watu na Salamu
• Nice to meet you, what’s up? - Nimefurahi kukutana nawe, habari gani?  [NimeFURAHI KUKUTANA nawe, haBIARI gani?]
• Good morning, how are you doing? - Habari ya asubuhi, unaendeleaje?  [HAbaRI ya aSUBUHI, uNAENDELEAje?]
